newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian H1 1997 aluminium output up 0.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Russian H1 1997 aluminium output up 0.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Russia produced 1.43 million tonnes of primary aluminium in the first half on 1997, up 0.1 percent from the same year-ago period, Interfax news agency quoted the Kontsern Alyuminiy producers group as saying Friday.
Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) producers Russia, Ukraine and Tajikistan produced 1.57 million tonnes in January-June, down 0.5 percent year-on-year.
Ukraine's primary aluminium output rose 7.5 percent year-on-year in the first half to 48,600 tonnes, while Tajikistan's fell 11.1 percent to 90,900 tonnes.
Kontsern Alyuminiy gave the following data for Russia's biggest aluminium plants --
RUSSIAN H1 1997 ALUMINIUM OUTPUT BY MAIN PLANT (TONNES)
Alyuminiy also said first-half 1997 CIS alumina production fell 1.9 percent year-on-year to 2.18 million tonnes, of which Russia produced 1.12 million.

Ukraine's Mykolayivsky alumina plant produced 419,000 tonnes in January-June 1997, 12.2 percent down on the first half of 1996. Output at the Zaporozhye works fell 3.6 percent year-on-year to 104,400 tonnes.
In Kazakhstan, the Pavlodar alumina refinery produced 543,600 tonnes in the first half, 3.4 percent higher year-on-year.
